connection.document:
mixed-port: 7890
proxies:
    -
        name: zn.node.vless.7
        type: vless
        server: edge.example
        port: 443
        uuid: CONNECTION_CREDENTIAL
        ws-opts:
            headers:
                Host: '美国 原名'
        dialer-proxy: zn.node.hysteria.8
    -
        name: zn.node.hysteria.8
        type: hysteria2
        server: '2001:db8::8'
        port: 443
        password: AUTHORIZED_PASSWORD
    -
        name: zn.node.trojan.9
        type: trojan
        server: unknown.example
        port: 443
        password: OTHER_CREDENTIAL
proxy-groups:
    -
        name: zn.group.7d6c0940067f8441016b14eb
        type: select
        proxies:
            - zn.node.hysteria.8
            - zn.node.vless.7
            - DIRECT
    -
        name: zn.service.ai
        type: select
        proxies:
            - REJECT
            - DIRECT
    -
        name: zn.service.media
        type: select
        proxies:
            - REJECT
            - DIRECT
    -
        name: zn.group.2ac3e0af3446c328d72b7721
        type: select
        proxies:
            - zn.node.vless.7
            - zn.group.f18b99b823e30f52efe4c111
            - zn.group.62642b95dd759de89cc3a26e
            - DIRECT
    -
        name: zn.group.f18b99b823e30f52efe4c111
        type: url-test
        proxies:
            - zn.node.hysteria.8
            - zn.node.trojan.9
        url: 'https://example.test/check'
        interval: 300
    -
        name: zn.group.62642b95dd759de89cc3a26e
        type: fallback
        proxies:
            - zn.node.hysteria.8
        url: 'https://example.test/check'
        interval: 300
rule-providers:
    ai:
        type: http
        url: 'https://example.test/美国 原名'
        proxy: zn.group.7d6c0940067f8441016b14eb
rules:
    - 'DOMAIN,美国 原名,zn.node.vless.7'
    - 'AND,((DOMAIN,a.example),(NETWORK,TCP)),zn.service.ai'
    - 'IP-CIDR,1.2.3.0/24,zn.service.media,no-resolve'
    - 'RULE-SET,ai,zn.service.ai'
    - 'MATCH,zn.group.7d6c0940067f8441016b14eb'
dns:
    nameserver:
        - 'https://1.1.1.1/dns-query#zn.group.7d6c0940067f8441016b14eb'
    nameserver-policy:
        'rule-set:ai': 'https://1.0.0.1/dns-query#zn.service.ai'
